input.rationale: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice periods and the Termination Payment; it contains no exit obligations. Nothing elsewhere in the Agreement supplies them: Section 1.5 export files apply only during operation, the confidentiality provisions (8.1-8.3) impose no return or destruction duty, and the survival clause (10.7) omits Sections 4, 5 and 8 entirely. HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and customer/order data, so the Agreement falls below even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus data export within 30 days) and risks the walk-away outcome of no data return. Inserted a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Content and customer/order data in a machine-readable format within 30 days of the Termination Date, and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide transition assistance and return Company Content and customer/order data on termination, then certify deletion.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The termination article is silent on exit, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our Content and customer/order data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback, but we need the data-return and deletion mechanics in order to migrate the Site without disruption.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including migration of the Site and the URL, for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer and order data relating to the Site or the Deerskin Products, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
